title.narrative: The Programme will result in: a) An improved and upgraded road between Meghri to Bavra of 556 kmb) Reduced congestion and improved levels of service on the project routec) Reduced road user costs, including vehicle operating costs, and increased time savingsd) Improved road safety conditions by reducing the high volume of accidentse) Improved conditions for transit trafficf) The Project is further expected to generate approximately 21.000 man years of temporary direct and indirect employment during construction. ve VET training for the formal and informal sector

description.narrative: The implementation of the Project will result in enhanced road capacity, improved alignment and smoother surface condition on the corridor, significant time savings for road users, as well as vehicle operating cost reduction and lower risk of accidents. The Project is expected to promote the economic and social development in Armenia and also in Georgia and contribute to improved regional integration and connectivity. Improved transport conditions will also improve the business environment thus the private sector activity and trade in the region. open distribution device and one high voltage substation and 3 traction substation
